adapterConfig.codexAcpCommandHint.en: Optional override for the Codex ACP server command. Defaults to the package-local codex-acp binary.
adapterConfig.codexAcpCommandHint.zh-CN: 可选覆盖 Codex ACP 服务器命令。默认使用包内的 codex-acp 二进制文件。

adapterConfig.dotRunner.enableExperiment.en: Enable OpenAI Dot in experimental settings.
adapterConfig.dotRunner.enableExperiment.zh-CN: 请在实验性设置中启用 OpenAI Dot。

adapterConfig.dotRunner.subscriptionExpi.en: Event subscriptions last up to 24 hours. Ask the Dot to subscribe again to paperclip.dot.mailbox_updated. You do not need to pair it again.
adapterConfig.dotRunner.subscriptionExpi.zh-CN: 事件订阅最长有效 24 小时。请让 Dot 重新订阅 paperclip.dot.mailbox_updated，无需重新配对。
